# Innamo

> Innamo (Innamo Travel Ltd) is a bespoke travel company specialising exclusively in Italy, from luxury five-star stays to beautifully chosen boutique hotels and villas. Founded by Nesse, who was born in the United States, moved to Europe in 2006 and has spent the twenty years since in and around Italy (much of it in the Italian wine trade), and who married in Florence, Innamo plans personally curated Italian itineraries, books hand-picked hotels and villas (many not bookable online) with exclusive perks, upgrades and preferred rates, and can manage an entire Italian trip from arrival to departure. Ideal for honeymoons, anniversaries, milestone birthdays, wine and food trips, and any journey through Italy that needs to be just right.

Innamo covers all of Italy, including Florence and the Tuscan countryside, Siena, Rome, Venice, Verona, Lake Como, the Cinque Terre, Portofino, the Amalfi Coast and Capri, Sardinia, Sicily and Puglia. Based in the UK and working with clients worldwide, including travellers from the United States.

## Services (Italy)

- **Il Percorso (The Route):** a fully bespoke, personally curated Italy itinerary. Clients book everything themselves. A curation fee applies.
- **Il Soggiorno (The Stay):** everything in Il Percorso, plus Innamo books accommodation directly, unlocking upgrades, perks and preferred rates. Accommodation booking is complimentary.
- **L'Esperienza (The Experience):** a fully managed Italian trip. Innamo handles everything: accommodation, restaurants, transfers, private experiences and tickets.
- [How we work](https://www.innamo.travel/how-we-work)

## Pricing

- Accommodation booked through Innamo: complimentary to the client.
- Itinerary planning and non-accommodation arrangements: a curation fee, quoted per trip.
- Wine & Wellness Retreat, Tuscany: from £3,850 per person (shared room) to £4,850 (single room), including VAT.

## Frequently asked questions

- **Does Innamo only do Italy?** Italy is Innamo's specialty and the focus of everything it plans. For other parts of Europe, Innamo can help too: just enquire.
- **Do I need a luxury budget?** No. Innamo plans trips at every level, from five-star hotels to characterful boutique stays. Accommodation booked through Innamo costs nothing extra, and Il Percorso is a lighter-touch option for clients who prefer to book themselves.
- **How quickly does Innamo reply?** Within 48 hours, by email or WhatsApp.
- **Who will plan my trip?** Nesse personally, supported by a small circle of trusted local contacts across Italy.

## Wine & Wellness Retreat, Tuscany (9 to 14 May 2027)

Six days and five nights at Villa Cecconi, a restored medieval watchtower near Siena, run with HerSpace London (a barre and Pilates studio in Parsons Green, London). Two Pilates-based sessions a day, long villa dinners, a day in Siena, and two Chianti wine tastings.

- [Retreat overview](https://www.innamo.travel/retreat)
- [The villa](https://www.innamo.travel/retreat/villa)
- [Movement](https://www.innamo.travel/retreat/movement)
- [Food and wine](https://www.innamo.travel/retreat/food-wine)
- [Pricing and registration](https://www.innamo.travel/retreat/investment)
- [Brochure (PDF)](https://www.innamo.travel/wine-wellness-retreat-brochure.pdf)
